title: PowerA MOGA XP7-X Plus Bluetooth Controller, New

comparisons.notes: New, factory sealed; part number XP7-X+ and MPN 1510706-01; page shows 9 in stock with free US shipping.
New condition, MPN XP7-X+, PowerA MOGA XP7-X Plus; 9 available.

writeup: Woot has the PowerA MOGA XP7-X Plus Bluetooth controller new for $24.99, limit 3 per order. It is an Xbox-licensed mobile controller that holds phones up to 7.13 inches and has a built-in 2000mAh power bank that charges your phone while you play. Multisurplus and its eBay store both charge $80.99 for the same MPN 1510706-01, so this is about 69% less.
amazon_match_notes: Exact ASIN B0B4V758R7 from the Woot offer; UPC 617885019975 and MPN 1510706-01 match the PowerA MOGA XP7-X Plus.
